notes: Library Commission minutes 1998-2010 (32 volumes). Curated: the Branch Library Improvement Program's design reviews and approvals, naming the architects of each branch renovation or new branch, and two branch renamings, onto existing branch pages.

coverage.remaining: Not placed: Mission Bay (design accepted September 19, 2002), Marina (Tom Eliot Fisch/Field Paoli, July 15, 2004) and Sunset (May 20, 2004) branches have no page; Parkside's and Presidio's architects already on their pages; the 1974-97 volumes, before the bond program, unread.

findings.description: The Library Commission approved the design for a $7.1 million renovation and 40 percent expansion of the branch: new wings beside the Carnegie building and a glass wintergarden on the 10th Avenue side, designed by the Department of Public Works' Bureau of Architecture with TBA West.
